value.rationale: A complete sharp stabilization law for varying preperiod at each fixed eventual period is a natural question about the logical visibility of the classical index-period invariant. The result identifies an optimal small representative and an explicit two-quantifier obstruction. The odd/even doubling originates in even exponent plus period divisibility, not an arbitrary numerical slice. No downstream theorem is claimed.
